title: Sanctus (Guerrero, Missa Sancta et immaculata virginitas)
desc: Francisco Guerrero, Missa Sancta et immaculata virginitas, Sanctus, before 1566. 5 voices (Superius 1º, Superius 2º, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
